title: Reto en Notting Hill: un piso para las vacaciones
goal: a describir un piso de vacaciones (qué hay y dónde está cada cosa) y a escribir un mensaje a tu familia

ex.t: Our flat is on a quiet street.
ex.es: Nuestro piso está en una calle tranquila.
La puerta de entrada es azul.

ex.t: There are flowers in the window.
The bathroom is at the top of the stairs.
ex.es: El baño está al final de las escaleras.

ex.t: My neighbour has got the keys.

vocab.note: En EE. UU. se escribe neighbor.

ex.t: The kitchen is on the ground floor.
ex.es: La cocina está en la planta baja.

vocab.note: En EE. UU. la planta baja es the first floor.

ex.t: There's a big carnival in August.
ex.es: En agosto hay un gran carnaval.

ex.t: Is there a supermarket near here?

pron.title: Repaso: th y las dos «i»
pron.tip: Practica frases completas: «There's a seat in the kitchen» (th suave en there, i larga en seat, i corta en kitchen). Ve despacio y exagera al principio; la velocidad llega sola.
words: There's a seat in the kitchen.

exercises.title: Holiday flat – Notting Hill
exercises.text: Beautiful flat on a quiet street, near Portobello Road Market. On the ground floor there's a living room and a kitchen. Upstairs there are two bedrooms and a bathroom. There isn't a garden, but there's a balcony opposite the park.

exercises.q: The kitchen is ___ the ground floor.
exercises.es: La cocina está en la planta baja.
exercises.why: Con las plantas de un edificio: on the ground floor.

exercises.q: The keys are ___ the neighbour, at number 12.
exercises.es: Las llaves las tiene la vecina, en el número 12.
exercises.why: Con una persona: with (with the neighbour).

exercises.es: Las toallas están en el armario.

exercises.q: In the flat have a balcony.
There's a photo of the carnival in the wall.
exercises.why: Lo que cuelga de la pared va con on: on the wall.

exercises.es: Hay una panadería enfrente del piso
exercises.answer: There's a bakery opposite the flat

exercises.q: There are some shops near the flat.
answer: Are there any shops near the flat?
exercises.why: Pregunta en plural: Are there any…?

exercises.q: El baño está al lado del dormitorio.
answer: The bathroom is next to the bedroom.
The bathroom's next to the bedroom.
There are flowers in the windows.
There are some flowers in the windows.
There are flowers on the windows.

exercises.context: Mandas un WhatsApp a Hugo para contarle cómo es el piso de vacaciones.
options: There are two bedrooms and there's a balcony.
Have two bedrooms and have a balcony.
There is two bedrooms and a balcony.
exercises.answer: There are two bedrooms and there's a balcony.
exercises.why: Dos dormitorios: there are; un balcón: there's.

exercises.context: El dueño te explica dónde están las llaves: debajo del felpudo, delante de la puerta.
options: They're under the mat, in front of the door.
They're on the mat, behind the door.
They're under the mat, opposite of the door.
exercises.answer: They're under the mat, in front of the door.
exercises.why: Debajo = under; delante de = in front of.

exercises.t: There's a lovely balcony opposite the park.
exercises.es: Hay un balcón precioso enfrente del parque.

dialog.title: Llegada al piso de Notting Hill
dialog.setting: Yolanda y su marido llegan al piso de vacaciones; les recibe la dueña

lines.t: Welcome! Come in. This is the living room.
It's next to the living room.
Is there a supermarket near here?
Yes, there's one opposite the station.
lines.es: Sí, hay uno enfrente de la estación.

realLife.t: Is there a supermarket near here?
realLife.context: Al llegar a un hotel o a un piso de vacaciones

summary: Describir una casa: there's a balcony, there are two bedrooms
Decir dónde está: next to, opposite, upstairs, on the ground floor
Preguntar: Is there a… near here?
Curiosidad: cada agosto Notting Hill celebra uno de los carnavales callejeros más grandes de Europa
